meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Vanuatu - International Company (IC) offshore regime under the International Companies Act [Cap 222]
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English Common Law, French Civil Law heritage and Melanesian customary law; unitary national system)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Agreement between the Government of the People's Republic of China and the Government of the Republic of Vanuatu for the Promotion and Protection of Investments (signed 2006)
Agreement between the Government of the Republic of Vanuatu and the Government of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland for the Promotion and Protection of Investments (1978)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap 222] as amended, including section 55A (confidential beneficial ownership register) and the licensed registered-agent due-diligence duties introduced by the International Companies (Amendment) Act No. 37 of 2014; Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 16 of 2024 and its subsidiary regulations; Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Act No. 10 of 1993; FATF Recommendation 24-25 implementation standards as assessed through the Asia/Pacific Group on Money Laundering (APG).
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (confidential beneficial ownership return maintained by the licensed registered agent and filed with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission; not open to public inspection)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport copies and individual identity verification files of directors, shareholders and ultimate beneficial owners
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the country of residence of each individual
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille issued by the competent authority of the country of origin (consular legalization only if the origin state is not party to the Hague Apostille Convention)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney executed by the beneficial owners authorizing the licensed Vanuatu registered agent and nominated directors to incorporate and administer the International Company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public / Vanuatu licensed registered agent witnessing execution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or consular legalization at a Vanuatu diplomatic mission for non-Hague states)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Beneficial Ownership Declaration and UBO Piercing Schedule (Form UBO-01) with corporate organizational chart annex
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed Vanuatu registered agent in conjunction with the declarant beneficial owners
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization followed by Hague Apostille where the declarant executes outside Vanuatu

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association and statutory declarations of proposed directors
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Founders' legal counsel and Notary Public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization according to the place of execution

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and professional due-diligence references for each material shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Originating bank or regulated professional firm
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (consular legalization if the issuing institution is located in a non-Hague jurisdiction)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing (issued post-registration for counterparty and KYC purposes)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (International Companies Division)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by the Vanuatu Ministry of Foreign Affairs, International Cooperation and External Trade (Hague Apostille Convention effective for Vanuatu from 23 April 2018)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory onboarding and ongoing screening against PEP definitions under the AML/CFT Act 2024 (domestic, foreign and international-organisation PEPs), the UN Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK OFSI list and Australian DFAT Consolidated List; adverse-media and FATF/APG jurisdiction-risk screening; enhanced due diligence for non-Hague-origin documents, higher-risk jurisdictions or PEP beneficial owners; statutory reporting to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit for large cash transactions and suspicious transactions as prescribed.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Company Registry Portal - International Companies Division (name search and reservation administered through licensed registered agents)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Names must be expressed in Latin-script English, French or (at the registrar's discretion) Bislama; no non-Latin transliteration is registered. Every International Company name must end with 'Limited' or 'Ltd' and must not be deceptively similar to any existing or reserved name on the register.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Extension: the licensed registered agent files a prescribed extension application with the VFSC International Companies Division before expiry of the 30-day reservation. Rejection appeal: within the prescribed window (typically 14 days) of the refusal notice, file a written reconsideration request through the registered agent with fresh name-search evidence and the prescribed VFSC fee; if the Commission upholds the refusal, the applicant may commence judicial review in the Supreme Court of Vanuatu under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] and the Civil Procedure Rules.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Accepted for offshore ICs: the company must maintain a registered office in Vanuatu at the offices of its licensed registered agent; a virtual or agent-based registered office is the standard permitted structure. Because the IC is tax-exempt only when it does not carry on business in Vanuatu, the physical assembly and calibration plant for multi-parameter ECG telemetry monitors must be situated outside Vanuatu. The business scope is flagged as requiring statutory license, but the substantive medical-device approvals (ISO 13485, CE marking or target-market FDA-type registration) are obtained in the destination market, not domestically in Vanuatu.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low_Likelihood (quantified at approximately 5-10% per annum): VFSC and the Vanuatu FIU inspect primarily on trigger events (complaints, adverse media, registered-agent AML audits); no routine unannounced inspection of the foreign manufacturing site is anticipated for a non-resident-owned, low-risk-tier offshore IC.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap. 222], Part 2 (Incorporation), Part 4 (Registered Office), Part 5 (Directors and Officers), Part 8 (Memorandum and Articles of Association)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Port Vila, Vanuatu
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Incorporation of an International Company (IC Form 1) together with Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is prescribed; at least one share must be issued and may be issued at no par value. No escrow account or mandatory capital deposit is required for an International Company.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the subscribers' subscription list is adopted, and the initial shares as entered in the register of members be issued to each subscriber named therein, effective immediately, with payment recorded on the statement of affairs. RESOLVED further that the registered office and registered agent of the Company, as filed with the Registry, be and are hereby confirmed; and the directors authorize that address for statutory notices and service. RESOLVED further that [Name] and [Name] be appointed first directors, that [Name] be appointed Chief Executive Officer/President, and [Name] be appointed Secretary/Treasurer; each officer is granted authority to open bank accounts, execute contracts, and make all necessary filings under the International Companies Act.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC International Companies Registry, Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (in-person counter or online portal at https://www.vfsc.vu)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the name reservation request naming the proposed International Company and two alternative names. Complete the availability search, pay the prescribed reservation fee, and obtain a name reservation letter that holds the name for the statutory reservation period.
required_dossiers: Form IC-NR01 Name Reservation Request
Passport copy of the applicant or principal shareholder
Letter of engagement from the licensed Vanuatu registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is rejected as identical or objectionable, resubmit with the alternative names or file a written review request to VFSC demonstrating that the name is available and not confusingly similar to an existing registered company.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Appointment of Registered Agent, KYC, and Preparation of Formation Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the registered agent agreement and provide all corporate KYC. Instruct the agent to prepare the Memorandum and Articles of Association reflecting the authorized corporate object of medical device assembly, calibration, and wholesale distribution. The agent drafts the statutory forms, share subscription list, and consent-to-act forms.
required_dossiers: Registered agent agreement
Certified passport copies of all shareholders and directors
Proof of residential address for each beneficial owner and director
Bank reference letter or source-of-wealth declaration
Technical description of the ECG patient monitor assembly and calibration business scope
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If KYC documentation is queried, provide apostilled or notarized originals through the agent. If the corporate-object wording is deemed too broad or incomplete, the agent files an amended objects clause before submission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of Incorporation Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public licensed by the Supreme Court of Vanuatu; Commissioner for Oaths
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Have each subscriber and proposed director execute the Memorandum and Articles, the share subscription instrument, consent-to-act forms, and the registered office notice in ink before a Vanuatu notary. Ensure the notary attaches a notarial certificate and that all documents are countersigned by the registered agent.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Instrument of share subscription and payment record
Consent to Act as Director and Officer forms
Notice of Registered Office and Registered Agent
Notarial certificate in English
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If notarization is rejected or the signature pages are defective, re-execute the documents before a Vanuatu notary and deliver a certified conformed copy to the registered agent.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing with the VFSC Registry and Payment of Government Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Vanuatu Financial Services Commission
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the completed incorporation pack, including certified true copies of the notarized Memorandum and Articles and the application form, with the VFSC Registry. Pay the statutory filing fee and obtain an official receipt and application tracking number. Confirm that all documents are in English and that the registered office and agent appointment are in force.
required_dossiers: Application for Incorporation (Form 1)
Memorandum and Articles of Association (conformed copy)
Notarial certificate and certification pages
Statement of first directors and officers
Registered office agreement
Proof of government fee remittance
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues a defect notice, correct the stated deficiency and resubmit the affected pages within the cure period. Any minor formal defect may be cured through a supplementary filing letter signed by the registered agent.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Collection of Certificate of Incorporation and Activation of Corporate Governance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Registry; then the Company's Board of Directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon confirmation of registration, obtain the Certificate of Incorporation and certified copies of the Memorandum and Articles. Convene the first board meeting, adopt the first board resolution approving share subscription, registered office, officers, and bank signatories, and authorize the opening of bank accounts and the commencement of industrial licensing applications.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Certified copy of Memorandum and Articles of Association
Statutory registers of members, directors, and charges
First Board Resolution and minutes
Consent and appointment certificates for officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate contains an administrative error in the company name or incorporation date, apply to the Registrar for administrative correction. If governance ratification is challenged, the directors may convene a validly constituted adjourned board meeting and ratify all prior acts pursuant to the Company's bylaws.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Department of Industry, Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry and Cooperatives; business licence issuance administered by the Commissioner of Customs and Inland Revenue under the Business License Act [Cap. 221]
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Vanuatu Business Licence (Manufacturing / Industrial Assembly of Electronic Patient Monitoring Equipment, ECG Multi-Parameter Bedside Telemetry Monitors, and Calibration Services)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation, Ministry of Climate Change, Adaptation, Meteorology, Geo-Hazards, Energy, Environment and National Disaster Management
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 2 - Environmental Registration and Environmental Management Plan; full Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) Report required only if the proposed facility will perform printed circuit board etching, generate hazardous waste above DEPC threshold quantities, or discharge process wastewater into environmentally sensitive waters.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Process wastewater from cleaning, calibration, and test stations must meet DEPC effluent criteria for heavy metals, including lead, cadmium, and mercury, and must not be discharged untreated to land, surface water, or municipal sewerage. Solvent and VOC emissions from soldering and flux removal must be captured by fume extraction systems and suppressed below workplace occupational exposure limits. Hazardous waste, including spent calibration solutions, solder dross, and defective electronic components containing restricted substances, must be segregated, labeled, and transported by a DEPC-licensed waste carrier. Ozone-depleting substances, CFCs, and halons must not be emitted as part of production processes.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety clearance from the Vanuatu Fire and Rescue Services certifying the assembly floor, calibration laboratory, and storage rooms as compliant with fire suppression, egress, and emergency lighting requirements. Structural load inspection certificate issued by a registered Vanuatu civil engineer for the production floor and equipment installation. Occupational health and safety clearance from the Department of Labour covering machine guarding, electrical safety, toxic fume exposure limits, eyewash and emergency shower facilities, and work-station ergonomics for precision calibration personnel.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (VRC), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management — Port Vila Central Office; online portal: https://www.customs.gov.vu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A Vanuatu International Company (IC) formed under the International Companies Act is not a domestic VAT/TIN-bearing taxpayer. A foreign-controlled IC must register with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) at incorporation, obtaining a Certificate of Incorporation and a VFSC company number rather than a domestic tax TIN. If the IC nonetheless carries on, or intends to carry on, a local taxable activity (which is generally prohibited for an IC), the officer or director must submit VRC Form VAT REG 01 together with constitutional documents, a VFSC Extract, notarised identification for directors, a Vanuatu business address, and overseas parent information; a VAT registration number is issued after verification and, where applicable, provision of a security bond. Non-resident exporters with no local fixed establishment need not obtain a domestic VAT identification number but must obtain a Vanuatu Customs supplier/importer code for export declaration processing.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box, hybrid mismatch, or fiscal-transparency election is available in Vanuatu. An International Company automatically receives tax-exempt-zone treatment under the International Companies Act and is exempt from all Vanuatu taxes, including VAT on qualifying offshore supplies; the only statutory 'election' is the annual government maintenance filing and a possible application to VRC for a certificate of tax-exemption or VAT zero-rating endorsement.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act [Cap. 248]
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 4,000,000 (Vatu four million) annual taxable turnover; registration is compulsory when turnover exceeds this threshold and voluntary below it if VRC considers registration appropriate.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal e-invoicing, tax-stamping, or continuous transaction clearance regime is currently implemented. Registered persons must issue serially numbered VAT tax invoices containing all statutory particulars and retain records for the applicable VAT period; export transactions are reported through the Vanuatu Customs E-Single Window (ASYCUDA World) using customs export declarations.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A VAT-registered exporter may zero-rate a supply of goods if the goods are physically exported from Vanuatu within 28 days, or within such extended period as VRC approves, documentary evidence of export is produced, and title and risk pass to the non-resident recipient; services are zero-rated when supplied to a non-resident and the services are performed outside Vanuatu or consumed wholly outside Vanuatu. An International Company's offshore sales of electronic patient monitors and ECG telemetry hardware must be routed through a registered exporter or local agent to support a VAT refund claim.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading / Air Waybill (non-negotiable original or certified copy)
Inward Remittance Certificate / SWIFT TT credit advice from a Vanuatu bank evidencing export payment
Commercial invoice and zero-rated VAT tax invoice
Certificate of Origin (where preferential tariff treatment is claimed)
Packing list and container or serial-number records for ECG devices and calibration instruments
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: VRC may audit exporters and disallow zero-rating where export documentation is incomplete or title or risk did not pass outside Vanuatu; penalties include recapture of VAT at 12.5%, late-payment penalties at 20% per annum, monetary penalties as prescribed in the VAT Act, and additional tax equal to 100% of the evaded VAT in cases of fraud; directors and principals are jointly and severally liable. Fraudulent use of export zero-rating may result in criminal prosecution, deregistration, customs penalties under the Customs Act, and public naming of the taxpayer by VRC.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) - Central Bank and Monetary Authority; Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) handles corporate and financial licensing; Foreign Exchange operations are administered by RBV under the Exchange Control Act [Cap. 62] as delegated to authorized dealers.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu maintains a largely liberalized exchange control regime with full current account convertibility for trade and service transactions and no prior RBV approval for remittances of profits, dividends, interest, or royalties by non-resident investors. Capital account transactions, including inward direct investment and repatriation of capital, require only classification disclosure through an authorized dealer and are not subject to quantitative restrictions. Profit remittance is unimpeded provided the International Company has filed its annual exemption certificate and maintains no local tax liabilities; no withholding tax applies on dividend distributions by Vanuatu International Companies. The national currency, the Vanuatu Vatu (VUV), is pegged to a reference basket of major currencies, but is not an offshore deliverable currency; practical USD account capacity is available in-country.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no statutory export proceeds surrender requirement, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no delivery timeline obligation in Vanuatu. Export receipts may be retained in foreign currency in an authorized dealer account or held offshore at the exporter's discretion, subject solely to bank-level record-keeping obligations under the AML/CFT Act [Cap. 299] and VFSC/RBV anti-money laundering directives.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific (BSP) Vanuatu Limited

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility: Low for licensing in Vanuatu. Vanuatu does not operate a dedicated electronic money institution (EMI) or digital bank licensing regime; offshore digital bank/EMI platforms (e.g., Airwallex, Wise, Mercury) are not locally regulated or supervised by the RBV or VFSC and cannot serve as the primary corporate treasury account for trade settlements routed through Vanuatu. They may be used only as auxiliary collection or payment rails if the entity also maintains a domestic account at an authorized dealer; local banks will require the primary account relationship to be with a physically licensed Vanuatu bank. Foreign-owned EMIs typically refuse to onboard Vanuatu International Companies due to correspondent banking restrictions.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is effectively mandatory for directors and authorized signatories. RBV and VFSC AML/CFT directives require face-to-face customer due diligence interviews for all non-resident companies; no fully remote account opening is available under the current domestic bank policies. A director or a senior authorized officer must appear in person at the bank's Port Vila branch in Vanuatu with original documents. Where a director cannot travel, a locally resident registered agent or appointed director holding an authorized signatory capacity may attend, but the bank will normally require a video-verified confirmation and notarized board resolutions to mitigate the absence.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate Beneficial Ownership concealment through nominee shareholders or bearer share structures
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Approved company register extract from the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission listing the current registered agent; executed UBO declaration form; apostilled or notarized trust deed or nominee declaration; Identification (passport), proof of residential address (utility bill), and source of funds documentation for each natural person with 10% or greater beneficial interest.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source of funds opacity for the initial capital injection and future trade-related cash flow
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified bank statements covering a 6-month period from the parent company's offshore account; sale-purchase agreements for ECG patient monitor components; supplier proforma invoices; payroll and operational expense forecasts; sworn declaration of lawful source of funds signed by the ultimate beneficial owner.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Discrepancy between the registered business scope (medical device assembly) and payment counterparty profiles
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: ISIC 3250 scope statement and product catalog; valid medical device export license or VFSC business license; clinical documentation demonstrating ECG equipment sales; distribution agreements with hospitals; list of expected counterparties with country exposure matching trade finance flows.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Rapid movement of funds or large inbound wire transfers inconsistent with company capital and asset base
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board resolution authorizing the specific transaction with signatory approval limits; detailed commercial agreements for the underlying shipment of patient monitoring systems; logistics evidence (bill of lading, airway bill); future cash-flow projection; commitment that no connected third-party loans will be routed through the account.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions or high-risk jurisdiction exposure of suppliers or customers on the payment corridor
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sanctions screening report generated by a recognized provider (e.g., Dow Jones, World-Check); documentary proof of end-use and end-user due diligence for medical devices; anti-circumvention certification confirming no nexus with sanctioned parties; regulatory classification of patient monitoring hardware as non-controlled medical device technology.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity or shareholder loan capital must be routed via the SWIFT network to the Vanuatu transit account at an authorized dealer using MT103 or MT202 with the purpose code classification 'Direct Investment' / 'Capital Contribution to Non-Resident Enterprise'. The remitter must include the company name, registered VFSC number, and a brief trade narrative (e.g., 'INVESTMENT CAPITAL FOR ECG PATIENT MONITOR ASSEMBLY OPERATIONS'). The receiving bank will complete an Exchange Control Form DCL (Dealer Classification) for RBV statistical purposes; no prior approval is required for amounts below VUV 100 million equivalent, but supporting board resolutions and shareholder loan agreements must be retained on file for verification. Identity verification of the remitting beneficial owner will be requested if the transfer originates from a non-bank financial intermediary.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary clearing rails include (a) SWIFT MT103 telegraphic transfers for advance payments, deposits, and settlement balances up to established transaction limits; (b) SWIFT MT700 commercial letters of credit issued by Vanuatu authorized dealers in favor of suppliers in Asia, principally covering assembly components for patient monitors; and (c) documentary collections (SWIFT MT400/MT750) for low-volume or repeat purchases. All disbursements must carry the trade purpose code for 'Imports of Medical Equipment and Accessories', and the underlying commercial invoice, packing list, and bill of lading must be presented to the bank within the statutory record-keeping window. USD-denominated payments route through the US correspondent network of the Vanuatu bank; VUV-denominated trades are limited to domestic settlements.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable FX forward contracts (USD/VUV) with authorized dealers, typically limited to 6-12 month tenors and supported by underlying trade exposure documentation
Cross-currency swaps with offshore counterparties for USD/AUD/NZD exposure on a best-efforts basis, requiring internal credit approval
Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for VUV via regional banks authorized to trade Vanuatu Vatu, permitted for treasury risk management only and not for speculative purposes
Foreign currency accounts held in USD at the Vanuatu authorized dealer acting as a natural offsetting hedge without separate derivative execution

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return and Annual Renewal Fee for International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), International Companies and Trusts Division
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after each anniversary of date of incorporation; annual government fee payable by the anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of VT 10,000 (approximately US$85) plus interest; continued non-payment results in automatic administrative strike-off from the International Companies Register and loss of limited liability protection

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory independent audit for a qualifying Vanuatu International Company regardless of turnover or assets; audit may be required by shareholder agreement, a financial institution, or if the company voluntarily elects to prepare audited financial statements
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No statutory financial statement filing requirement; if financial statements are prepared voluntarily, IFRS or applicable local GAAP may be used

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must obtain and maintain up-to-date beneficial ownership information; on each annual return anniversary, the registered agent must confirm that the register of members, register of directors, and UBO record accurately reflect any shareholding transfers and beneficial ownership changes since the last confirmation

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not required; if voluntarily audited, approximately US$2,500 – US$5,000 per engagement

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% — Vanuatu levies no national corporate income tax.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: International Companies (ICs) are granted a full statutory tax exemption under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]: no CIT, no capital gains tax, no payroll tax, no social security levy, and no GST/VAT on exported medical device transactions. The only government charges are the VFSC annual license fee and the licensed registered agent fee. Foreign-source income is completely outside the Vanuatu tax net.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VFSC Annual Return (IC Act Form) — filed electronically through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) I-Track online registry; accompanied by payment of the annual government license fee.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual (anniversary-based; one return per calendar year period following incorporation).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within thirty (30) days after each anniversary of the date of incorporation. No CIT annual return is filed because the IC is tax-exempt; the VFSC annual return is the only compliance filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered name, VFSC registration number, date of incorporation, and registered office address in Port Vila.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors must insert overseas service address for correspondence; the Vanuatu registered address must be supplied by the licensed agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name, license number, and address of the VFSC-licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A Vanuatu-licensed agent is mandatory; non-resident persons cannot act as registered agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full legal names, residential addresses, nationality, and passport numbers of all directors.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors are permitted; certified/notarized copy of passport and utility bill must be retained by the agent under AML/CFT rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part D — Shareholders and Beneficial Owners
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full details of all members, classes of shares held, and ultimate beneficial ownership declarations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Shareholder register is kept at the registered office and is not publicly accessible; non-resident UBO details are disclosed only to VFSC/agent under AML law.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized capital, par value per share, issued share count, and paid-up capital.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No minimum capital requirement; leave paid-up capital as nil if no share premium/exempted consideration; no attestation required from foreign banks.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the IC has not carried on business with Vanuatu residents, has not solicited business from the Vanuatu public, and is compliant with the International Companies Act.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be signed by the director or the authorized company secretary; a false declaration by a non-resident director is criminally punishable in Vanuatu.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late annual return filing triggers a fixed late-filing penalty plus a late-payment surcharge on the annual government fee under the VFSC fee schedule; no daily surcharge is prescribed. Continued non-filing or failure to pay the government license fee leads to automatic strike-off from the register, forfeiture of the separate corporate legal personality, and a reinstatement fee equal to the back fees plus the Registrar's administrative costs.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — no dividend withholding tax is imposed on distributions by a Vanuatu International Company (Vanuatu does not operate a withholding tax regime for dividends).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has not concluded comprehensive Double Taxation Agreements (DTAs); only limited Tax Information Exchange Agreements (TIEAs) exist with certain OECD partners. Consequently, the DTA-relief/TRC route is not triggered for Vanuatu-sourced dividends because the domestic WHT rate is zero. Where a foreign recipient jurisdiction requires proof of Vanuatu residence for foreign tax credit purposes, the registered agent may apply to the Vanuatu Department of Customs and Inland Revenue for a Certificate of Tax Residency (TRC). Submission package: (i) VFSC Certificate of Good Standing; (ii) notarized Certificate of Incorporation; (iii) directors' resolution declaring management and control in Vanuatu; (iv) copy of the filed VFSC annual return; (v) agent cover letter. The TRC is issued in approximately 5–10 business days and does not itself create Vanuatu tax liability.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory: 0% for IP royalties and 0% for debt interest remitted by a Vanuatu IC to non-residents (no withholding tax regime exists in Vanuatu). Treaty: no applicable DTA rates; effective rate remains 0% regardless of the recipient's residence. A foreign payer, however, remains subject to its local WHT when paying royalties or interest into the Vanuatu IC, unless that foreign jurisdiction's domestic law exempts the payment.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory threshold in Vanuatu Vatu (VUV): Vanuatu has not enacted transfer pricing or BEPS documentation legislation, and International Companies are tax-exempt. Local File/Master File preparation is therefore not mandatory in Vanuatu. Practical compliance benchmark for cross-border ECG monitor intercompany sales: maintain an OECD-aligned benchmarking note covering 3–6 comparable distribution transactions to withstand foreign downstream TP audits.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu does not apply Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) equivalent to BVI/Cayman. A VU-IC must engage a VFSC-licensed registered agent and maintain a registered office in Port Vila, but no statutory requirement exists for local physical office, local employees, local management, or an economic substance test. The IC must nevertheless refrain from trading with Vanuatu residents, holding Vanuatu real property, or carrying on banking, insurance, or trust business within Vanuatu; any such conduct violates the IC Act declaration and exposes the company to sanctions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly submitting a false annual return declaration asserting that the IC has conducted no domestic Vanuatu business, or using the IC as the final invoicing leg for ECG patient monitor assembly/calibration profits actually earned by a foreign operational subsidiary, thereby exploiting the 0% Vanuatu headline rate while management and control sit offshore.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Making a false statement in any document required under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] is an offense punishable on conviction by a statutory fine and/or imprisonment of up to two years; the VFSC may refuse renewal of the IC license, strike the company off the register, and require rectification filing. Proceeds of tax evasion abroad may also trigger foreign consolidated GAAR/CFC assessments with penalties of 50–100% of tax understated plus interest.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false declarations are personally prosecutable in the Vanuatu Supreme Court; civil fraudulent-trading remedies allow the court to pierce the corporate veil and order restitution from the directors' personal assets. Criminal travel bans and passport surrender can be imposed pending trial; upon conviction, disqualification from managing any Vanuatu company and custodial sentence apply.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the Vanuatu IC as a passive routing drawer for Swift LC and TT wire payments linked to medical device sales, with no independent decision-making, no risk-bearing capacity, and no staff or premises, in circumstances where the substance requirement is enforced by foreign tax or banking counterparts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: No standalone Vanuatu ESR penalty exists; however, VFSC may decline the annual license fee renewal and strike off the IC where it appears to have no legitimate economic purpose. In the destination market, the recharacterization of 100% of remote ECG monitor sale profits typically triggers corporate income tax at rates up to 30–40%, plus late-payment interest and negligence penalties of up to 100%, and customs valuation penalties for overstated invoice values.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Courts applying the doctrine of piercing the corporate veil may fix personal liability on directors who structured the sham; freezing orders over personal bank deposits, travel bans, and seizure of travel documents have been granted in asset-preservation proceedings. Foreign directors remain extraditable for fraud where predicate offenses fall within applicable extradition treaties.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML / Money Laundering and Financial Circuit Abuse
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Engaging the VU-IC's beneficiary bank account for rapid in-and-out transfers, accepting payments from undisclosed counter-parties, processing round-tripped or inflated invoices (e.g., ECG unit priced at multiple times the book value to move funds), or transacting with a sanctioned state, while the IC lacks any physical trade infrastructure.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Anti-Money Laundering and Proceeds of Crime Act No. 13 of 2001 (as amended), money laundering is punishable by a fine of up to VUV 10,000,000 and/or imprisonment of up to twenty years; the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit may freeze all bank balances held by the IC; the VFSC may suspend or revoke licenses held by the registered agent and ban the company from reincorporation. Banking rails (Swift/TT) will be terminated by Vanuatu correspondent banks for AML breach.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Beneficial owners and directors risk criminal conviction, confiscation of proceeds under the Proceeds of Crime Act, personal fines, imprisonment, statutory travel bans, and prohibition from re-entering Vanuatu; the AML Act also pierces the corporate veil to attach the personal assets of directors who directed suspicious transfers with knowledge or wilful blindness.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Unlicensed Medical Device Manufacturing and Unapproved Export
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Assembling, calibrating, or distributing multi-parameter bedside telemetry monitors (ISIC 3250 / NAICS 334510) without (i) the required Vanuatu business license under the Business Licence Act (as amended) for any physical activity in Vanuatu, (ii) destination-market device conformity or regulatory approvals (CE, FDA 510(k), MDR, or other), and (iii) valid commercial export permits and correct HS classification for customs clearance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Carrying on business without the required license is a criminal offense under the Business Licence Act, carrying statutory fines per contravention plus forfeiture of relevant equipment and closure of premises; customs authorities may seize misdeclared ECG monitor consignments; importing regulators can order recalls, impose monetary penalties under the EU MDR or US FDA civil monetary penalty regimes, and institute product-liability claims for patient harm.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and principal officers can be named personally in product-liability and personal-injury suits, with unlimited damages exposure in the destination jurisdiction; culpable negligence or manslaughter charges prosecuted against officers in serious patient-death cases lead to imprisonment, alongside Vanuatu-court travel bans, seizure of personal assets, and permanent director disqualification in both Vanuatu and the importing market.
